issues.on_page: Department columns pp14-17: Police contracted services 163,036; Rescue 74,213; Fire Maintenance 69,744; Pool 181,447; Library 227,375; Park 251,976; Park & Recreation 158,710; Cemetery 29,026; Street Lighting 46,773...
issues.issue: [fixed] Most General Fund spending is public safety, culture/recreation, health/welfare (cemetery) or streets (street lighting). The fund statement p5 itself shows General Fund general government at only 542,883 of 2,049,253. Putting the whole Total column under general government misstates the function for about 1.4 million, and loses the department headings the rules call for. Record the lines department by department (or at least give each its correct function).

This is a last-resort category. Keno/sales-tax community betterment spending usually fits economic development or culture/recreation. Marked review; a person should decide. The same applies to detail[30].
These are repayments of notes receivable (the economic development loan program), not revenue of an ordinary kind. No category fits exactly; defensible, but check it (the same applies to detail[33]).
Street Fund intergovernmental revenue is almost certainly highway allocation/incentives (detail category 'highway allocation'), though the page doesn't break it down.
